settings.title: The Lookbook
settings.intro: Seven rooms, styled with SSKOI flowers. Vases shown are styling props.

settings.title: An easy morning
settings.note: Set a low, round vase on a small side table near the light. Angle a few of the blooms outward to show the layered petals from both sides.
settings.alt: Baby Pink Austin roses in a cream stoneware vase on a linen-draped side table by a window

settings.title: White at the door
settings.note: Keep the arrangement compact in a straight-sided vase. Angle a few outer stems and let the narrow white cups break the line at different heights.
settings.alt: White tulips in a clear glass vase on a white oak entry console

settings.title: Room for a few stems
settings.note: Try a few branches in a matte vessel by your favorite chair. Leave some space between the blooms so you can see the buds and flocked leaves.
settings.alt: Light peach ranunculus branches in an olive stoneware vase beside a book
settings.detail_alt: Close-up of a round ranunculus bud and the soft gray-green surface of a flocked leaf
settings.detail_caption: A closer look at the flocked leaves and round buds.

settings.title: White by the basin
settings.note: A few tulip stems fit beside a sink. Keep the flower cups just above the rim of a ribbed glass vase and leave room for everyday things.
settings.alt: White tulips in a ribbed glass vase on a limestone bathroom vanity

settings.title: A little peach at dusk
settings.note: Set a few branches in low pottery, where you can see the small green buds and the texture of the leaves.
settings.alt: Light peach ranunculus beside rumpled linen bedding

settings.title: Coral on the counter
settings.note: Use a few coral branches in a small jug. Let the closed buds sit a little higher so their shapes stay visible.
settings.alt: Coral classic roses in a gray stoneware jug on a white oak kitchen counter
settings.detail_alt: Coral classic rose blooms and tapered buds arranged diagonally on linen
settings.detail_caption: Open blooms and pointed buds along the branches.

settings.title: Pink between the books
settings.note: Try a small grouping in a low vase between books. Turn one bloom out so its center catches the light.
settings.alt: Baby Pink Austin roses in a low terracotta vase on a walnut bookshelf
